verdict.rationale: Supabase documents Read Replicas for load balancing, latency, and redundancy (supabase-docs-21/39), but the evidence pack contains no documented failover mechanics (e.g., automatic promotion, RTO/RPO, or HA guarantees) beyond the general 'redundancy' mention.
